summary: The Form 6-K filed by Allied Gold Corp on May 14, 2026, attaches a press release announcing Q1 2026 financial and operational results. The press release reports production of 96,016 gold ounces, net loss of $58.3M, Adjusted EBITDA of $173.3M, and cash of $424.2M. It also mentions progressing a transaction with Zijin Gold, but no specific deal terms, percentage, price, or approval details are provided. The filing is a routine earnings report and does not constitute a special situation transaction. No board recommendation, advisor, structural mechanics, or closing timeline are discussed.
